page.notes: Marginal notes are in the right margin, beside the text. The word "Vsurpata." is a single marginal word; it is printed beside the line "vel παραιτητικὰς" and is read as "Usurpata." The Greek words are copied as best as the scan allows. Words marked [?] are uncertain: the Greek accents, the superscript letters after "vel", and the last Greek word "παρα[?]ις" are not fully legible. The line ending "li" is a fragment that continues on the next page. Where the printed hyphen was part of a line-break, it is kept.
